topics.purpose: Define a read-only/candidate-edit Expose monitor for site style, brand tokens, assets, UI labels, translations and fallback/completeness state.

semantics.readonly_rule: Default monitor is read-only; edits create candidates.
semantics.identity_rule: Style, asset, label, translation and internal resource identities remain distinct.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing/editing presentation candidates grants no domain authority.
semantics.failure_rule: missing asset/translation/conflicting token states remain explicit.
semantics.internal_rule: Localized UI never mutates internal command identifiers.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.
